page.overview:
Who is Javicco Corrino?

Javicco Corrino was the fifth Emperor of the Known Universe. He was the only son and heir of Roderick Corrino.

The Dune Encyclopedia names the fifth emperor of the Corrino Empire as Henoor II Negara I.
